folding-order-main/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "folding-order"
version = "0.3.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "5-stage RG flow for temporal anomaly detection — the Ground Truth algorithm"
authors = ["Cocapn Fleet <fleet@cocapn.ai>"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/folding-order"
keywords = ["anomaly-detection", "timing", "constraint", "rg-flow", "eisenstein"]
categories = ["algorithms", "science"]

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
